findings.label: Autoscroll during long streams
findings.detail: The autoscroll effect depends on `messages`, which changes identity on each rAF flush, so it re-runs during streaming. Whether `scrollToEnd` keeps the newest tokens pinned as content height grows during a long reply was not runtime-verified (the coder's note scopes out live RN runtime verification). Confirm on device; if it lags, trigger a scroll from the flush path. Not blocking — UX detail, not a correctness or compile issue.
